text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan achieved a magnificent 
victory in the Satsuki Sho. She reflected 
upon the sight of victory earned with 
everything she had, as well as how much 
she had grown since her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, on the other hand, vivid traces 
of the running of Yaeno Muteki and Sakura 
Chiyono O, whom she had faced, still 
lingered strongly within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to get complacent, Mejiro Ardan 
vows to channel today's result into 
success for the Aoba Sho and the Nippon 
Derby beyond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono 
O were reminded once again that Mejiro 
Ardan would be a major threat in the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by the outcome of the Satsuki 
Sho, the two fire themselves up to seize 
victory in the Japanese Derby this time 
around.
